text:
The MGAP National Forest Cartography (version 2021), from Uruguay's Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries, is the source that characterizes the loss area as planted forest. It maps 68.1 ha of the event area as planted forest, with the species listed as Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. A further 13.2 ha falls outside mapped forest, and 0 ha is native forest.

Two caveats:
- Hansen GFC (81.3 ha of loss in 2021) and JRC GFC2020 (98% forest agreement) don't identify forest type. They only show loss and forest presence.
- The MGAP map gives territorial context, not cause. Mapping the area as pine plantation doesn't establish that the loss was a harvest, or whether it was legal or who was responsible. About 84% of the loss area (68.1 of 81.3 ha) is mapped as planted.
